sourceTracks.description: A collection of tracks representing the canonical source of a video.

tracks.description: The canonical list of tracks specifying the source of a video.

sourceClip.description: An object representing that this video's source is a clip from another video.

video.description: AT URI of the video we're clipping.

start.description: Start time of the clip in milliseconds.

end.description: End time of the clip in milliseconds.

muxlTrack.description: A track backed by a MUXL container

trackId.description: ID of the track within the MUXL container.

type.description: Type of the track: video, audio, or text.

blob.description: A MUXL blob in one of the MUXL-supported formats.

ref.description: BLAKE-3 content hash (BDASL CID) of the archive.

muxlType.description: MUXL type of the archive (mp4, fmp4).

size.description: Size of the file in bytes.
